heading: Reservations
lead: From the amounts appropriated under section 6603(b) of this title for a fiscal year, the Secretary shall reserve—

tree.text: to carry out activities authorized under subpart 1—

children.text: 49.1 percent for each of fiscal years 2017 through 2019; and

children.text: 34.1 percent for each of fiscal years 2017 through 2019; and
